lines.2: 「I am a teacher. Dance with another student.」
lines.3: 「Director, this counts as building friendship between students and teachers, right?」
lines.4: 「Of course, of course! I encourage it!」
lines.5: 「There you have it, Ms. Inori! It's part of the school event.」
lines.6: 「Using Mr. Tachibana against me... Very well.」
lines.7: 「What? We can dance with Ms. Inori too?!」
lines.9: A stampede of male students surges in like a swarm of locusts.
lines.10: 「My, my. This will only cause confusion.」
lines.11: 「I had better not participate after all.」
lines.12: Ms. Inori swiftly turns and slips away.
lines.17: The Sports and Martial Arts Festival ends in a frenzy from beginning to end.
